description: Supreme Court of Sri Lanka - Supreme Court Rules - 2018
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointment of a specific date for Supreme Court Rules to come into force. It is a legal/regulatory matter concerning the implementation of court rules, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) rather than government personnel or structural changes. The mention of the Chief Justice's name does not constitute a government personnel appointment but rather serves to identify the authority making the legal notification.
